# Complete the exact unfinished F4 increment

Prior native actor reached the operator-selected128-turn cap and delivered no
completed handoff. Its exact partial codec/store changes are already present at
53acfe7c6a51e0b0a1d354fbc79ef3d391cb7573, unaccepted. Do not restart discovery or
discard those changes. Read this task/grant, REENTRY_TRIAGE.md and the closed
INSTALLED_FIXTURE_FEASIBILITY.md owner map first. This continuation has256 turns.

Root selects the existing c_workflow child -> retained E/S/T input -> deterministic
consumer fixture relation described in that review, including its closure and
pre-install import premises. It fits the existing test-file grant. Use the exact
canonical contract and binding through the supplied Product owner; do not
redeclare a framework contract or add a loader/registry/authority.

Complete the owning HOW decision first, then finish/adjust the partial codec and
store only as necessary for the already selected invariants. Add the required
negative/cold/atomic/captured component cases and installed case, complete the
RC5 identity/source-claim changes, and return one frozen honest handoff. The
prior partial implementation has no acceptance credit. Its Native failure and
after-observation remain preserved; a new successful return must be genuine.

The prior noEmit/in-memory author feedback is historical. The broad in-memory
codec attempt timed out a child; no passing compiled verdict exists. Do not
repeat that loader suite. Type/syntax checks may be used; the declared C2 plan
will compile and exercise the complete selected candidate after return.

All required final proof interfaces and the original immutable seven-command
C2 recipe remain under rc5-operator-inputs/f4-01/. Those recipe, seed, sample,
retained-method and exclusion inputs are unchanged. This f4-02 task/grant is
the operative continuation contract; any f4-01 execution metadata is historical.

The complete original bounded outcome follows, with source/scratch coordinates
updated for this continuation. No new Product scope or source owner is granted.

# RC5 retained-route carriage and successor identity

Root selects this increment from checkpoint 53acfe7c6a51e0b0a1d354fbc79ef3d391cb7573
under the owner's approved RC5 scope and ROOT_REPRICING.json. The method source,
independent review and eighteen actual C2 passes are held; prior native UAT
remains indeterminate because one affected planning case was omitted. Its Root
diagnostic now passes. This Run must close that residual on the final candidate.

Use the existing F4 re-entry in ../F4_REENTRY.md and its pinned measurement.
Source development uses STDO 3.0.4. Installed RC4 remains the immutable builder
with its original STDO 3.0.2 runtime basis. Preserve all prior evidence and cuts.
Invoke .claude/skills/stdo-work/SKILL.md as recipient of this task and
NATIVE_GRANT.json. Read those first, then the owning HOW and codec/store.

Implement one coherent private durable representation change: a retained-route
event may omit only its nested boundInput.value.source body when that body is
the exact earlier admitted Result consumed by the route. Preserve the full
logical RuntimeEvent and all value/payload/event/route identities, lineage,
currentness and refusal behavior. Routes consume authority; they do not become
body sources or new admission authority. Keep v1/v2 histories readable.

The measured population contains 15 eligible sources, 155,009,467 gross JSON
bytes before reference overhead. All 15 source Results already use the existing
physical body-reference codec. Supporting only physically inline Results would
save zero bytes on that population. Preserve the exact same-Run/cCall Result
membership while acquiring its existing earlier body dependency through the
durable owner. An equal-valued basis, foreign occurrence or digest alone cannot
substitute for the consumed Result. Inline fallback remains valid when an exact
eligible representation is unavailable or larger. Counterfeit references refuse.

Re-enter the owning HOW before code. Resolve ordinary private representation,
helper and algorithm choices within this grant. Reuse event_store's existing
history/index/acquisition, codec and staged append/rollback. No new store,
sidecar, event stream, service, configurable registry, Public schema/controller,
constructor or native identity redesign. Do not rewrite historical event files.
Do not expand this into other body carriage, caches or a cold-history rewrite.

Required affected proof must distinguish exact admitted membership from body
equality: real Result already physically referenced, same-valued basis and
foreign-occurrence decoys, missing/forward/tampered/uncommitted source or body,
mixed inline/reference form, rollback and failed fsync/poison, and full,
selected and descriptor cold reconstruction. Use actual owner seams; synthetic
lower premises remain labelled. A logical/value/replay difference rejects the
candidate. Measure net encoded bytes on the same valid workload, including
reference overhead; no universal latency or capacity claim follows from size.

Select package identity 5.0.0-rc.5 through the existing package.json, lockfile and
Product constant owners. Keep logical schema/workflow versions at their owning
unchanged 5.0.0 meaning. Amend the stale source release-claim only to an honest
bounded local unqualified RC5 candidate statement with actual residuals. This
does not qualify, tag, publish, merge or change a global selector.

C2 owns compilation, existing generators, package formation and selected tests.
Root owns exact generated-output adoption and the eventual no-clobber local
cut/install. Do not manually edit generated contracts, build/package on the
canonical source, or modify the immutable operator recipe. Return one frozen
candidate with chosen owner relations, changed paths, actual author feedback
and residuals. Independent max review runs alongside the affected C2 proof.

Use the existing test owners t287-event-body-encoding.test.mjs and
m5-installed-graph-edge.test.mjs. New selected component and installed cases
must have titles beginning "RC5 retained route". The installed case must
exercise the new retained-source physical representation through an installed
candidate and fresh result/replay, not merely an ordinary small graph route.
Existing installed-language-test and structural-fixture sourceTransform seams
are available; choose the smallest valid fixture within the granted test file.

The immutable C2 recipe runs: the exact omitted selector planning case, the
complete event-body-encoding and route-reconstruction files, and the installed
graph-edge file. It reuses eighteen actual method passes only after verifying
their exact producer and unchanged method/qualification bytes. Do not edit the
six retained method source files, generated inputs, recipe or exclusions.
PROOF_EXCLUSIONS.json explicitly distinguishes unselected capture/live cases
and full qualification from the selected final proof.

CAPTURED_ROUTE_SAMPLE.json carries three exact physical rows from the measured
historical campaign: inline body37940, already-referenced Result37953 and
route37961. Its custody does not make it a complete admitted history. Exercise
the candidate codec on the sample, assert identical reconstructed logical
events/digests, and emit a test diagnostic with this exact interface:

    t.diagnostic('RC5_RETAINED_ROUTE_MEASURE '+JSON.stringify({
      sample:'captured-route-37961', beforeBytes, afterBytes,
      netSavedBytes:beforeBytes-afterBytes, logicalUnchanged:true
    }))

Count actual serialized physical records including reference overhead under
the same newline convention. Additional explanatory keys are welcome. The
component/installed owner tests separately establish valid admission, atomic
publication, currentness and cold reconstruction; the sample alone cannot.

One coherent Construction, actual C2 Testing, then native UAT. The bounded HOW
decision is included in Construction; no separate design/induction cycle is
needed. Any new integration failure returns to Root for triage; do not silently
retry or broaden. Save changed paths, owner choices, actual local feedback and
residuals to rc5-scratch/f4-02/return.json and short readiness evidence to
readiness.json. Optional noEmit/in-memory author checks may use the read-only
offline dependency link; C2 alone compiles/builds/packs the actual candidate.
Stop editing at the native return so independent review and C2 inspect one cut.
